about: Every number and claim this lesson shows or says, with its source. Angi's help article 'Angi Leads: Frequently Asked Questions' (intercom.help/angi, article 6207184, 'Updated over a year ago', no date) re-read Nov 7, 2026 (Central) with WebFetch in the proven lane build chat; both quoted lines were on it that day. HomeAdvisor's 'Leads: Frequently Asked Questions' (prohelp.homeadvisor.com/leads-faq, no date) read the same day backs the meaning (charged whether or not you open or respond) and is not said or shown. The 2 pm roof call, the shop and the card's text are ours (EXAMPLE on screen). We never say how much a lead costs, how many pros call back, or that the first caller wins: no source here gives any of those.
